import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int LOGN = 19;

    static int mult(int a, int b, int p) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % p);
    }

    static int fpow(long n, long k, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) r = r * n % p;
            n = n * n % p;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)r;
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static void addmod(int[] a, int idx, int val, int p) {
        a[idx] = (a[idx] + val) % p;
    }

    static void submod(int[] a, int idx, int val, int p) {
        a[idx] = (a[idx] - val + p) % p;
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len << 1) {
                for (int j = i; j < i + len; j++) {
                    int u = a[j];
                    int v = a[j + len];
                    if (invert == 0) {
                        a[j + len] = (u + v) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[j + len] = (v - u + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (int)((long)r[i] * a[j] % p)) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (int)((long)r[i] * r[j] % p)) % p;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subset_pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        while ((n & (n - 1)) != 0) {
            n += n & -n;
        }
        int[][] fa = new int[LOGN][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[LOGN][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[LOGN];
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = pow_convol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < LOGN; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOGN; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        int nn = 0;
        int[] f = new int[n + 1]; // temporary, will resize later
        int maxT = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= (i >> j) & 1;
                    }
                }
                if (t > maxT) maxT = t;
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        // resize f to maxT+1
        int[] f2 = new int[maxT + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxT; i++) {
            f2[i] = f[i];
        }
        f = f2;
        nn = maxT;

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        int[] fac = new int[n + 1];
        int[] ifac = new int[n + 1];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }

        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a[i] = ifac[f[i]];
        }

        int[] conv = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p);
        int res = fpow(k, n, p);
        res = (res - mult(conv[nn], fac[n], p) + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
